subject: Future Tech
title: Why Colonize Space?
description: A quick win: understand Why Colonize Space?.

hook.text: Earth is the only home humanity has ever known. A single asteroid or pandemic could end our entire species.

buildup.text: Stephen Hawking warned that humanity must become multi-planetary within centuries to ensure long-term survival.

discovery.text: Space colonization isn't just insurance. It offers access to unlimited energy, minerals, and room to grow.

twist.text: Every previous human migration was to a place with air and water. Space has neither, making this the hardest move ever.

climax.text: SpaceX, NASA, and China are all building hardware for permanent settlements beyond Earth within this century.

punchline.text: One planet is a single point of failure.

quiz.question: Who famously warned humanity must become multi-planetary?
